article_context: Body image immediately before the section about delayed flights home; it supports the promise that guests can spend unexpected waiting time at the resort comfortably and enjoyably.
image_reading: Two smiling women stand on an open mountain-resort terrace, each holding a colorful drink.
Green mountains and string lights frame a bright, relaxed summer setting; the women are the clear focal point.

models.positive_prompt: The two women keep their warm smiles as they gently raise their drinks toward each other in one unhurried toast; a light breeze moves loose hair. Fixed camera on them. By the final frame both glasses are held close together at chest height and their relaxed smiles remain.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the women make one calm, coordinated toast-like lift without touching glasses: their drinks rise smoothly toward the center while their friendly expressions stay relaxed. A faint breeze moves hair and the terrace lights softly. The camera remains fixed on the pair; near the end, both drinks settle close together at chest height and the women are still smiling.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed shot on the two women as they slowly lift their drinks toward one another, maintaining relaxed, happy smiles; a soft breeze stirs their hair. End with both glasses held close together and the mountain terrace mood unchanged.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, let the two women begin lifting their already visible drinks promptly and steadily toward one another, using a modest shared motion that develops through most of the clip. Their hair shifts lightly in the mountain breeze. Keep a fixed camera; the motion eases naturally near the end with the glasses close together and both women visibly at ease.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the women. They smoothly raise their drinks toward each other with easy smiles while a light breeze moves their hair. In the final frame the glasses are close together at chest height and both women remain relaxed.
models.scene_plan: Within four seconds, use a focused, gentle lift of the two drinks toward the center of the pair. The movement begins immediately, stays even, and is supported only by slight wind movement in their hair. Hold the camera fixed; arrive near the end at clearly raised glasses close together, with the same carefree expressions.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: An unexpected delay on the way home can still be spent comfortably and pleasantly at the resort.
structured_intent.primary_action: The two women gently raise their drinks toward one another.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The pair remain relaxed, cheerful guests enjoying the resort atmosphere.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Both women hold their drinks close together at chest height while smiling.
